profile.text: Ansel is a member of Reserve Op Team A4 and a citizen of Rim Billiton. Before officially taking up his post, he was a member of the Rhodes Island pharmaceuticals intern staff. After excelling on multiple tests, he was permitted to join the Rhodes Island medic team.
